title: Service Requests and Service Call Fees, Real Estate Service Contracts
content:
## Acceptance of service requests

Service requests under a Real Estate Service Contracts plan are accepted only while the contract status is listing coverage, closed pending payment or active. The status is read from the system record of the contract the request is placed on.

A request placed while the contract is in listing coverage is a seller listing request placed by the seller; a request placed on or after the closing is a buyer request placed by the buyer.

## Service call fees

- A new failure request is charged the plan's seller-phase service call fee in the seller phase and the plan's buyer-phase service call fee in the buyer phase, once per request.
- A recall for the same item placed no later than the plan's repair guarantee period, in calendar days, after the earlier repair was completed carries no fee, and a later return visit is a new failure request.
- The fee is refunded in full when the caller cancels the request before any contractor is assigned, or when the request was placed on a plan that is later voided; it is not refunded because the failure is determined not covered.

| Request type | Phase | Fee charged |
|---|---|---|
| New failure | seller phase | the plan's seller-phase service call fee, once per request |
| New failure | buyer phase | the plan's buyer-phase service call fee, once per request |
| Recall for the same item within the repair guarantee period | either | no fee |
| Rekey | buyer phase | no fee |

The plan's service fee balance is the service call fees collected on the contract's service requests and not refunded.

## The rekey benefit

- The rekey benefit is available only in the buyer phase on plans whose rekey lock count is above 0, covers up to the plan's rekey lock count of exterior keyed locks once per order, and carries no fee.
- **Request window.** A rekey request is accepted only when it is placed no later than the plan's rekey request window, in calendar days, after the sale closes, counting from the day after the closing date with the boundary day included. The clock starts from the sale closing, as shown by the closing date on the contract record.

| Rekey request placed (plan whose rekey request window is 30 days; days counted from the day after the closing date) | Request window |
|---|---|
| day 30 (the boundary day) | met |
| day 31 | not met |

## Fee refund Q&A

**Is the fee refunded when the caller withdraws the request after a contractor has been assigned?** The rule refunds the fee in full on a caller cancellation before any contractor is assigned; a cancellation after assignment is not among the refund cases this rule lists.

**Is the fee refunded when the failure is determined not covered?** No. A not-covered determination is not a ground for refunding the fee.
